description: This file declares functions for Base64 encoding and decoding within the 'cuttlefish' namespace, providing interfaces for encoding arbitrary data to Base64 strings and decoding Base64 strings to byte buffers.

methods.name: EncodeBase64
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a Base64-encoded string.

methods.name: DecodeBase64
methods.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded string into a byte buffer.
